en: The postcard features an old photograph of an expansive river landscape with forested hills, a wooden structure likely related to logging (possible log flume), and log rafts on the river. The front has printed and handwritten Swedish text, and a postal stamp from Sweden dated 1901. The address side uses Swedish address conventions and includes an old Swedish postage stamp.
